schema:
CREATE TABLE employee (
  firstname,
  gender,
  hiredate,
  lastname,
  locationID,
  performance,
  positionID,
  salary,
  ssn
);

CREATE TABLE location (
  address,
  locationID,
  locationcity,
  officephone,
  state,
  zipcode
);

CREATE TABLE position (
  educationrequired,
  maxsalary,
  minsalary,
  positionID,
  positiontitle
);
